brand.name: Shopify
brand.summary: Shopify is an all-in-one commerce platform that enables merchants of all sizes to build, customize, and manage online, mobile, in-person, and B2B retail operations. It provides robust tools spanning website building, AI assistance with Sidekick, secure checkouts, payments, shipping, and workflow automation.

competitor_analysis.brand_overview: Shopify provides a complete commerce platform empowering solo entrepreneurs and enterprise global empires to sell everywhere through online storefronts, AI chat, mobile apps, and point of sale.
